Nuclear CAPACITY mandate: force total nuclear capacity (standalone nuclear plus the gen side of nuclear storage-hybrid wrappers) to follow a national deployment trajectory. 0=off; 1=floor (capacity >= trajectory); 2=equality (also capped at the trajectory; can be infeasible if prescribed or existing capacity exceeds the scaled trajectory). Distinct from GSw_GenMandate, which constrains generation share. Not applied before new nuclear can be built (firstyear).
